story.title: How it started
story.p1: We met in the most ordinary way — a chat that was meant to last a minute and turned into a walk along the Poprad. Barcice and Piwniczna have been our shared landscape ever since.
story.p2: The proposal was quiet: rings, a date on a watch, and the decision that 28 September 2024 would be our day. Thank you for celebrating it with us.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: The practical bits — so you do not have to call the couple at the last minute.

parking.q: Is there parking at the venue?
parking.a: Yes, Las Vegas Residence has a large car park for wedding guests.

church.q: How do we get from the church to the venue?
church.a: About 10 minutes on DK87 from Piwniczna-Zdrój to Barcice. A shuttle also runs after mass — mark a seat in the attendance form.

kids.a: Yes. Note the number of children and a nap corner in the attendance form comments.

diet.q: How do we flag a diet?
diet.a: Pick an option in the attendance form or describe an allergy in the notes.

dress.a: Evening formal. Skip sports shoes on the wooden dance floor.

stay.a: Yes, the resort has 2- and 3-person rooms. Request a stay in the attendance form — there are fewer rooms than guests.

gifts.a: Your presence is enough. If you wish to add something — wine, a book or a travel contribution. We do not publish an account number.

photos.q: Where will photos appear after the wedding?
photos.a: In the gallery on this site. We will email the film and the full photographer set when they are ready.

witnesses.title: Witnesses
witnesses.subtitle: Questions about the bus, rooms or seating — write to Ania or Tomek.
